Fresh from the pan

Photos from the shop and from guests in the Google listing.

A small shop for one sweet

Kunafa House in Kyriakou Matsi Street makes one thing: Palestinian kunafa, prepared to order in a few minutes and served hot, with the cheese still soft. The shop is small, with a table inside, most guests take their kunafa away or order it for delivery. On Google, guests praise the balance of crispy, cheesy and sweet, the pistachio and the classic version, the friendly owner and the clean shop, and many call it the best kunafa in Cyprus. There are also pistachio chocolate bars and Arabic coffee.

Tuesday to Thursday 11:00 to 13:00 and 16:00 to 22:00, Friday 16:00 to 22:00, Saturday and Sunday 11:00 to 13:00 and 15:00 to 22:00, closed on Mondays.
